Name: ExtraNpcChat
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a flexible framework for adding custom NPC chat lines. If you are tired of ready-made dialogue packs, you can create your own dialogue with simple JSON files. It supports original villagers and custom NPCs from other mods. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI first.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Put the [/color]

[code]ExtraNpcChat[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into your [/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game via SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Put your own dialogue JSON files inside the dialogue folder of this mod.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Write custom NPC dialogue with JSON[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Weighted random selection for dialogue groups[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Conditions: weather, season, heart level, time and more[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multi-page dialogue, set separate emote for each page[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Separate Shared / Male / Female dialogue pools[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Special rule to avoid out-of-character lines for non-town NPCs[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works with custom NPC mods[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Latest SMAPI[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community. [/color]

Manifest.Name: ExtraNpcChat
Manifest.Description: Adds optional extra small-talk dialogue with any NPC (villagers, festival visitors, merchants, modded NPCs), driven entirely by your own JSON files. Does not replace or override vanilla dialogue; triggered by a separate hotkey.
Manifest.Author: 冰酒
